messages:
Casey: Heads up — the new inbound dashboard is showing a big drop in MQL->SQL conversion for the last 48h, looks concentrated in paid webinars. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:
Priya: I saw that earlier, yeah. Looks like UTM_source=partner_webinar has a ton of raw leads but almost zero engagement. Could be a tracking or routing mismatch.
Liam: pulled a quick event-level check: `SELECT utm_source, event, count(*) FROM leads WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1,2` — partner_webinar has +420 leads, but `demo_request` only 12. Suspect `lead_router_v2` is classifying them differently.
Nora: @Priya FYI we changed the CTA on the partner landing last week to "Join live" which intentionally funnels to the nurture flow. That might be the cause.
Casey: If they're being funneled to nurture we should see that in the funnel. Right now the KPI board marks them as MQLs but they never hit SQL.
Liam: looking at raw logs — many rows have `lead.source_detail = 'partner:xyz'` and no `utm_campaign`. Our fallback attribution uses `source_detail`, which could be inflating partner_webinar counts.
Priya: Can analytics add a `final_routing_bucket` column to the dashboard? Would help us tell routing vs conversion issues.
Liam: I can add that column and backfill, but it'll take a day to run the backfill. For immediate triage I can run a cohort join: `SELECT l.id, l.utm_source, r.bucket FROM leads l JOIN routing_events r ON l.id = r.lead_id WHERE l.created_at > '2026-03-18' AND l.utm_source = 'partner_webinar'` and summarize.
Nora: I'll ping SalesOps — if these leads are intentionally in nurture we shouldn't treat them as conversion failures. @Casey want me to loop them in now?
Casey: Please do. Also propose we add an "active routing" overlay on the KPI chart so any routing rule changes are obvious in the trendline. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Priya: +1. Also let's add an annotation to the weekly KPI board explaining the landing CTA change so it doesn't get treated as a pure performance regression in the benchmark narrative.
analytics-bot: Dashboard update scheduled: adding `final_routing_bucket` column to the `marketing_funnel_v2` view. ETA: 24h. Backfill window: 30 days.
Casey: Great — once we have backfill + SalesOps confirmation we can decide whether to adjust attribution or just annotate the weekly benchmark. For now let's avoid changing historical benchmarks until we confirm.
Priya: Sounds good. I'll add a note to the weekly KPI doc and block a 15m sync if we need one after SalesOps replies. :spiral_calendar:
Casey: Thanks team.
